SELECT 'inheritor' AS type, i.id, i.display_name AS title, i.portrait AS cover, i.profile AS summary, i.skill_type AS category, NULL AS level_code, i.region_code AS region_code, NULL AS price, NULL AS start_time, i.recommend_sort AS sort_value FROM inheritor i WHERE i.audit_status = 1 AND i.status = 1 AND i.display_status = 1 AND ( i.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.profile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.skill_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND 1 = 0
AND i.region_code = #{regionCode}
UNION ALL

SELECT 'product' AS type, p.id, p.name AS title, p.cover, p.description AS summary, pc.name AS category, NULL AS level_code, NULL AS region_code, p.price, NULL AS start_time, (0 - COALESCE(p.sales, 0)) AS sort_value FROM product p LEFT JOIN category pc ON pc.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND 1 = 0
UNION ALL
